blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of current front, back and three-quarter: jacket remains plain ivory with a broad flat diagonal lavender panel, sparse buttons and oversized elbow diamonds; rear has no clear tailoring or finishing.
Standing skirt remains long, near the knee, with strongly faceted pleats and an abrupt waist transition; proportions and surface still diverge from the short pleated concept.

Crouch and sit directly show exposed fitted shorts and large rigid triangular side flaps. Current same-pose ray coverage for the overskirt is 0.5593/0.5582 on crouched left/right upper thighs and 0.4497/0.4576 seated. The 55 mm bilateral center fade did not improve the prior measurement and remains prototype-only.
Direct prone inspection shows the skirt and torso compressed into a broad irregular fan with angular folds; orderly drape is not achieved.
Arms-up and arm-cross still show sleeve and underarm faceting, and elbow diamonds read as large surface decals rather than restrained quilted patches.
Back and side views show a featureless rear panel and abrupt waist-to-skirt transitions with faceted side folds; no finished back adjustment detail is visible.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
